name: Party Club: Hangry Animals
description:
About This Game

Welcome to the Party. Friendship Is Optional.

This is a fast, ridiculous multiplayer party game made for up to 4 players, whether you’re playing online, on the same couch, or across platforms.

Quick rounds, simple controls, and a growing collection of mini-games mean one thing:
chaos happens fast, and it happens often.

One second you’re winning.
The next second you’re eliminated, exploded, or politely launched into space.

👥 Play Anywhere, Argue Everywhere

  • 🎮 Up to 4 players

  • 🛋️ Couch (local) multiplayer

  • 🌐 Online multiplayer

  • 🔄 Cross-platform play

Sit next to each other. Play from different countries. Either way, someone is going to blame someone else.

🎲 Mini-Games? Oh, We Have Mini-Games.

Here are some of the mini-games we finished.

  • Thrust Issues – Physics has opinions. Bad ones.

  • Furball – Cute. Violent. Both.

  • Shots Fired – Aim… panic… fire.

  • Mix It Up – Best mixologist wins.

  • Hit & Run – Run run run. Do the hitting. Avoid the consequences.

  • Furblast – Explosions were a design choice.

  • Sky Bar – Falling is part of the experience.

  • Fit Check – Who will be the fastest interior designer.

  • Claw & Brawl – Low to the ground, high aggression. Is that a plane?

  • RC Chaos – Tiny cars. Big disasters.

  • Meteor Panic – Dodge, smash, scream.

  • Hoop Buddies - Basketball game with one hoop

  • Sip Snatchers – Serve fast. Steal customers faster.

  • Neon Labyrinth – Paint the maze. Repaint your friends.

  • Monkey Heist – Punch monkeys. Sell bananas. Question nothing.

  • Prop Panic – Find the prop. Become the prop. Run.

  • Cup Defence – Fill cups. Throw cups. Stop the horde.

  • Garden Panic – Plant. Harvest. Expand. Panic.

  • Chef Forecast – Place your bets. Season the outcome.

  • VIP Ride – One ride. Zero sharing.

  • Spotlight Runner – Stay in the spotlight. Push everyone else out.

  • Soup Or Sink – Stay afloat. Everything else is dinner.

  • Snack Attack – Cross the road. Save the fruit. Dodge everything.

  • FurWars – Protect your egg. Break theirs. Breathe occasionally.

  • WHAT'S THE NEXT GAME? YOU DECIDE

Lets see some games. Shall We?!

Furball

Kick, dash, and totally miss the ball in Furball mini-game! It’s chaotic soccer game where teamwork matters until your friend scores an own goal and everyone laughs anyway.

In this 5-minute madness, the team with the most goals takes the cup. Catch drinks for power up. If it’s a tie, get ready for sudden death. First goal wins! May the best (or luckiest) team win.

Furblast

Step into the explosive fun of our bomber party game! Up to 4 friends can battle it out in fast-paced matches where the first to win 2 matches wins the game. Be careful about skunks and pigs.

Claw & Brawl

Fighting arena for up to 4 players! Battle your friends in chaotic brawls filled with punches, dodges, and flying mayhem. Watch out for incoming planes and meteors. Only the toughest survive!

Each match lasts 5 minutes. Defeat as many opponents as you can while avoiding death.

Whoever gets the most knockouts with the fewest deaths wins. Stay alert for planes and meteors. They can take you out at any moment!

Fit & Check

Think you’ve got what it takes to be the fastest restaurant designer in town? In this exciting two team challenge, you’ll race against other team to set up your dream restaurant in a limited space!

You’ve got a total of 5 minutes, but the race doesn’t have to last that long. The first team to finish their restaurant setup takes the win! Every second counts, every inch matters!
Place tables, machines, and all the must-have items as fast (and as smart) as you can.

SkyBar

Deliver drinks, dodge rivals, and cause chaos in the sky. Up to 4 players race against time to serve customers while flying. Use cards to boost your power or sabotage your opponents. And yes, helicopter crashes are totally allowed!

Each match lasts 5 minutes and supports up to 4 players. Pick up ordered drinks from the machines and fly them to customers by helicopter. Use cards to gain special abilities or block your rivals. Collide, compete, and deliver The fastest and smartest pilot wins!

🎯 Features That Cause Problems (In a Good Way)

  • 👥 Local & Online Multiplayer

  • ⚡ Short, high-energy rounds

  • 🎲 Random mini-game selection

  • 🎮 Easy controls, unfair outcomes

  • 😂 Perfect for parties, streams, and loud rooms

Winning is fun.  Losing is usually funnier.

💬 Got Ideas? Join Our Discord.

Got a crazy mini-game idea?
Found a bug?
Or just want to yell about that one round you definitely should have won?

👉 Join our Discord and be part of the chaos.

  • 💡 Share your mini-game ideas

  • 🛠️ Give feedback directly to the devs

  • 🎮 Help shape future updates

  • 👀 Get early looks at upcoming content

Early Access means the game grows with the community — and Discord is where it happens.

Don’t forget to join our Discord and tell us your wildest ideas.


Some of them might actually end up in the game.

🎉 Final Warning

This game may cause:

  • Sudden shouting

  • Friendly trash talk

  • Not-so-friendly trash talk

  • “One more round” syndrome

Wishlist now, invite your friends, and let the chaos begin.
short_desc: A chaotic party game for up to 4 players — online, on the couch, and across platforms. Jump into ridiculous mini-games, betray your friends equally on every device, and embrace the madness.
